notes: Return legs, parameter variants, before/after rules and CPU variants are correlated, not independent samples.
Red is the first player. Mixed-policy outcomes require policy attribution, not first-player fairness interpretation.
CPU timing is diagnostic under concurrent local tests, not a controlled performance benchmark.
Authored tundra is an asymmetric defensive mission; its outcomes are mission success, not first-player fairness.
Repair expense measures actual serialized upkeep, including a final end-turn handoff before an adjudication.
Undecided at the comparison horizon is not a draw.
